Stage 2 = the wrapper as a TAB ROUTER, which is what makes one window serve every repo: the extension spawns claude through claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper with the workspace's first folder as cwd; the wrapper instead (1) shows a picker on each new-tab launch — WSLg is on (guiApplications=true), so zenity/yad can list every repo's coordinator and registered builders from .fabrik/session-agents.json + the ledger's merge owner, plus 'new session in <repo>'; (2) cds into the chosen repo, exports CLAUDE_AGENT=<role> (and the pinned account vars when set), and appends --resume <that role's live session id> when one exists (so the chosen coordinator's own conversation opens, hooks and CLAUDE.md load from the chosen repo, the transcript lands under that repo's project dir); (3) cancel = plain launch in the workspace folder. The extension's own history list stays the first folder's — cosmetic; resume comes from the picker. Keep the stage-1 log. Measure: a youtube-coordinator tab opened from the fabrik window answers whoami youtube-coordinator and writes to projects/-opt-youtube. Risks to test: the extension passing its own --cwd/--add-dir args, the picker blocking the extension's start timeout, two tabs resuming one session id (one tab per sid, D-922 class). Design (small spec) first, then build; box-local, full /fabrik-review (operator-named). HELD until the operator hears this narration.
